name: Node · Vite + React
description: Node.js with npm and pnpm. Runs your Vite dev server with hot reload, or scaffolds a React + TypeScript app.
startup:
# Node/Vite: install deps with the repo's package manager, then run the dev server on 0.0.0.0:5173 (scaffolds React if no repo).
export CI=1
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  [ -d app ] || npm create -y vite@latest app -- --template react-ts --no-interactive </dev/null
  cd app
fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pm=pnpm; pnpm install --config.dangerously-allow-all-builds=true || exit 1
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then pm="corepack yarn"; $pm install || exit 1
else pm=npm; npm install --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps || exit 1
fi
[ "$pm" = npm ] && set -- --; exec $pm run dev "$@" --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort

name: Python
description: Python 3 with venv, pip and pipx. Installs requirements.txt into .venv.
startup:
# Python: venv + requirements; serves the project directory on :8000 until you replace this.
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
[ -f requirements.txt ] && pip install -q -r requirements.txt
exec python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0

name: Go
description: Latest Go toolchain. Runs the main package of your module.
startup:
# Go: fetch modules and run the main package (expects it to listen on :8080).
[ -f go.mod ] || exit 0
go mod download
exec go run .
